summary: Ring-buffer non-consuming read (peek). If the requested byte count a3 is at most the available-byte count at this+0x1002, copies a3 bytes from the buffer starting at the head index this+0x1000 into the output buffer a2, wrapping the local read position modulo 4096. The head index and available-byte count are not modified, so the data remains in the buffer. Returns 1 on success, 0 when a3 exceeds the available bytes.
